notes.rateHtml: Rate — the indicator relative to population: cases per 100,000 people for deaths, and per 10,000 people for morbidity (national and regional), i.e. count ÷ population × 100,000 (or × 10,000). Rates are taken as published by the source, not recomputed here. Compare groups and years with different population sizes by rate, not by count.
notes.deltaHtml: Change — the relative change of the rate against the previous year for the same indicator (or the same region/district): (this year's rate − last year's rate) ÷ last year's rate × 100. It compares rates, not counts, and is a percentage, not percentage points. ▲ increase, ▼ decrease, → only at exactly 0%. “—” means there is no data for the previous year.
notes.covidHtml: COVID — in 2020–2021 the value changed by ≥10% against 2019 (up or down).
notes.estHtml: estimate — the source published a fractional (non-integer) count; most likely an estimated/preliminary figure.

about.heading: About the project
about.p1: Cardiostatistics is an open website that brings together cardiovascular disease statistics for Azerbaijan. It presents death and morbidity indicators for diseases of the circulatory system (ICD-10 I00–I99) by year, age group, economic region and district.
about.p2: The site shows the latest year's key indicators, trend charts over the years, a map of Azerbaijan by economic region and district, and a sortable table of all indicators. It is available in Azerbaijani and English.
about.p3: The data comes from the official health tables of the State Statistical Committee of the Republic of Azerbaijan (Azstat); the source is checked every day and the site is updated when new data is published. It is intended for researchers, physicians, students and journalists.
privacy.meta.title: Cardiostatistics — Privacy Policy
privacy.meta.description: Privacy policy for the Cardiostatistics website and mobile app: what personal data we don't collect, our data source, and hosting.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Short version: we don't collect personal data.
privacy.intro: Cardiostatistics (website and mobile app) is a simple way to view public statistics. It does not collect personal data about its users, does not require an account, and keeps no profile.
privacy.noDataBody: The site and the app never ask for, store, or share any of the following with a third party:
privacy.noData.name: Name
privacy.sourceBody: Every figure shown comes from the open tables of the State Statistical Committee of the Republic of Azerbaijan (Azstat), checked and updated daily. This is public source data, not data collected from how you use the site or app.
privacy.prefsBody: Your chosen language (AZ/EN) and appearance (light/dark) are saved only on your own device — in the browser's localStorage on the website, and in AsyncStorage in the mobile app. This choice is never sent to us; it stays on that device only.
privacy.hostingBody: The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. Like any web server, the hosting provider (GitHub) may keep standard technical access logs on its own side for a short time (e.g. IP address, browser type, page requested) — this is the hosting provider's ordinary technical log, not something Cardiostatistics itself collects.
privacy.disclaimerBody: All information on the site and in the app is statistical in nature and is not medical advice. Please consult a doctor for personal health matters.
